info.title: Oomuro-ke: Dear Sisters
info.synopsis: Spin-off della serie Yuru Yuri incentrato su Sakurako e le sue due sorelle.

info.title: Delico's Nursery
info.synopsis: La storia segue Dali Delico, il capo di una delle più prestigiose famiglie aristocratiche in un mondo gotico dove i vampiri vengono cresciuti come nobili ed è presente il leggendario vampiro originale TRUMP che si ritiene abbia vita eterna.

episodes.title: Una piccola avventura
episodes.synopsis: Gli adulti sono stupefatti dal giovane Theodore che mostra segni del suo ingresso nella fase della crisalide a un'età così giovane. Intanto, gli altri bambini portano con sé Ul per una piccola avventura fuori dal maniero.

episodes.title: Benvenuti alla Nursery
episodes.synopsis: Dali Delico è un vampiro aristocratico che sta trascurando i suoi doveri al lavoro. Ma quando alcuni suoi colleghi vanno a visitarlo per discuterne con lui lo trovano a prendersi cura di un bambino piccolo...

episodes.title: Una spirale di complotti e accudire bambini
episodes.synopsis: In cambio della sua partecipazione alle indagini Dali richiede che gli investigatori stabiliscano la loro base operativa nel suo asilo, costringendoli a dare una mano sia per la missione che per l'accudimento dei bambini

episodes.title: Un'ombra che serpeggia
episodes.synopsis: Pendulum, un'organizzazione criminale che venera il Vamp primigenio noto come TRUMP sembra essere coinvolta nel caso e guarda caso Dali sembra avere un conto in sospeso con loro

episodes.title: Una maledizione chiamata amore
episodes.synopsis: Raffaello, il figlio di Dali, è entrato nella sua tanto temuta fase ribelle. Geloso delle profuse attenzioni che Dali dà al suo figlio più piccolo, Ul, Raffaello desidera che il suo fratellino muoia...

episodes.title: La seconda Nursery
episodes.synopsis: In allerta per un potenziale attacco di Pendulum alla residenza Delico, gli uomini mandano i bambini a stare con Clara, la balia dei Delico. Ma sta succedendo qualcosa di strano al bambino più grande, Theodore...

episodes.title: Una piccola avventura
episodes.synopsis: Gli adulti sono stupefatti dal giovane Theodore che mostra segni del suo ingresso nella fase della crisalide a un'età così giovane. Intanto, gli altri bambini portano con sé Ul per una piccola avventura fuori dal maniero.

episodes.title: Uno scontro tra le fiamme
episodes.synopsis: Dali e compagni vanno a recuperare i bambini dopo la loro piccola avventura, ma si potrebbero ritrovarsi a lottare più duramente del previsto per riaverli indietro…

episodes.title: Thus Spoke Juras
episodes.synopsis: After he deduces that the bandaged member of Pendulum, Juras, is a survivor of Nebula Village, Dali seeks out another known survivor in pursuit of a lead.

episodes.title: The Battle of Gray Cat Town
episodes.synopsis: Dali learns from Banri that Juras is in Gray Cat Town. Meanwhile, the members of Pendulum, who've taken the children hostage, find that they have their hands full looking after them.

episodes.title: How to Kill God
episodes.synopsis: Dali and his team uncover Pendulum's hideout and rescue Lord Johannes along with the children, but now Clara and Ul have been kidnapped...

episodes.title: The Clan Festival
episodes.synopsis: Pendulum is after a teacher by the name of Krauss—TRUMP's alter ego. In order to prevent them from making contact, Dali and the team rush to the Clan.

episodes.title: Sweet Dreams
episodes.synopsis: As a dhampir, Juras doesn't have long left to live. In an attempt to kill TRUMP before he expires, he uses his cocoon phase power to enter the deity's mind.

episodes.title: End of the Nursery
episodes.synopsis: Non abbiamo una descrizione tradotta in inglese. Aiutaci ad espandere il nostro database aggiungendone una.

info.title: Monster Rancher (ITA)
info.synopsis: Genki è un ragazzo appassionato di videogiochi che viene magicamente teletrasportato all'interno del suo videogame preferito. Al suo arrivo in questo mondo virtuale, in cui convivono umani e mostri, il giovane si imbatte in una ragazza di nome Holly e nel suo mostro, Suezo. Insieme ai suoi due nuovi amici Genki dovrà salvare questo mondo dalla terribile tirannia di Master Moo e dei suoi generali.

episodes.title: L'avventura di Genki
episodes.synopsis: Genki is a young boy with an ordinary, dull life. That is, until he gets a new game in the mail. He soon gets pulled in and must now fend for himself within the game. He soon comes across two friends, Suezo and Holly. But, will they be able to stop the terrible monster, Moo?

episodes.title: Sono Mocchi
episodes.synopsis: Genki, Mocchi, Holly, and Suezo continue on their trek. Genki is concerned, however, that Mocchi is becoming a softy, so he decides to leave him with an elderly couple they meet outside of a town. Genki wants Mocchi to stay with them, but Mocchi refuses and shows his friendship toward Genki by helping him defeat the Black Dinos.

episodes.title: Arriva Golem
episodes.synopsis: Genki and friends come across an "enigma", a Golem that does not like to fight. They invite him to join their quest, but when Moo's troops threaten the Golem's “Garden of Lost Disks”, they discover a terrible secret about him!

episodes.title: La rinascita di Worm
episodes.synopsis: Genki and his friends encounter Alan, a young boy who is strict and cruel to his pet Worm. When he tries to ally with agents of Moo, however, he learns that loyalty is something that is given and not taken.

episodes.title: Tiger il tornado
episodes.synopsis: Genki and his friends come across a group of bandits in the desert, led by Tiger of the Wind. He steals the Magic Stone, but the Baddies turn all of his friends into Mystery Disks and injure him. When Genki and his friends save him, he helps them defeat Captain Dino and then joins them.

episodes.title: Io sono Hare
episodes.synopsis: Genki and his friends reach a town with a giant coliseum! Tiger battles Hare, who cheats his way to a victory. Genki and the others soon forgive him and Hare offers to buy them dinner and a place to stay the night. In the morning, Hare runs off and leaves them the bill, but Tiger catches up and makes him pay. Hare apologizes, and joins the group.

episodes.title: I fantastici sette
episodes.synopsis: Genki and his friends come across a beautiful valley with a small village at the foot of a dam. When Moo's troops damage the dam, Genki and the monsters must work together to save the town from utter disaster!

episodes.title: Il segreto di Holly
episodes.synopsis: Holly's past is finally revealed! She shares her story with the gang on a miserable, rainy day. She tells of how she came to be on the quest for the Phoenix with Genki and the others.

episodes.title: L'uccello di ferro
episodes.synopsis: Genki and his friends continue their journey, and find a huge canyon, as well as a beat-up airplane. They take the plane, but has Genki been double-crossed by the pilot? The group must fend off the evil Kuro in order to get out of this predicament.

episodes.title: La sfida
episodes.synopsis: Genki and friends arrive in Heaven Canyon via the iron bird. In the canyon are humans mining “mystery disks” under the oppression of Moo. Are Genki and his friends strong enough to defeat them and free the imprisoned humans?

episodes.title: Genki incontra Pixie
episodes.synopsis: After scaling a cliff, Genki and Mocchi must free their captured comrades and find a way to defeat Clay, Pixie, and Big Blue!

episodes.title: La storia di Monol
episodes.synopsis: In search of a mysterious disk, Monol tells of a great story from the past.

episodes.title: Master Moo si rivela
episodes.synopsis: Genki and friends meet paths with the infamous Moo. Will they be strong enough to defeat him?

episodes.title: Un aiuto inaspettato
episodes.synopsis: The Searchers, aided by the Pirate Dragons, infiltrate Moo's castle. Moo tells of how he left the village and was infused with Holly's father. He also gives Holly his dagger, which was Holly's father's, to prove it. Then Genki and his friends save her, with the help of Pixie.

episodes.title: Una nuova partenza
episodes.synopsis: The Searchers arrive to the ocean, and encounter Horn, the self-proclaimed righteous pirate. They try to get him to give them a ride across the ocean, and fight Gali's Zuum troops at the same time.

episodes.title: Battaglia in mare
episodes.synopsis: On the high seas, the team is attacked by Moo's Zillas and their leader, Gooji. Unless Golem can overcome his fear of the water, this may be the end for Holly!

episodes.title: Hare ci ripensa
episodes.synopsis: After trying a shortcut, the team becomes trapped in a mysterious underground cave. Will they be able to find their way out when Moo's sinister Joker and the Evil Hares are there to wreak magic havoc?

episodes.title: Un nuovo amico
episodes.synopsis: The Searchers discover an ancient city, perfectly preserved by Hengers. But, the robot caretakers are programmed to prevent anyone from entering it! When the Hengers take Holly's pendant, Genki and his friends must trust a malfunctioning Henger, who was banished from the city because of his free will, to find a way inside.

episodes.title: L'arma segreta di Suezo
episodes.synopsis: Suezo has always been happy to let others do the fighting for him. But, his friends have begun to take him for granted, and when Hare points out that he has no Special Attack, Suezo takes the criticism pretty hard. Genki begins to try and train him, but does Suezo have the courage it takes to show what he can really do?

episodes.title: Di nuovo Pixie
episodes.synopsis: Pixie returns, and helps Genki in a battle against a group of Scale Jells. But she and Genki become separated from the others, and when Pixie gets injured, she finds she must rely on Genki to survive. At first, she is embarrassed and angry. But Genki's compassion begins to wear away at the barrier of hatred she has built around herself.

episodes.title: L'arma segreta di Mocchi
episodes.synopsis: The Searchers finally confront Gali, the second of Moo's Big Four. Gali is both charming and clever, and manages to trap Genki and the others in a pit. But Mocchi escapes the trap, and the young monster must fight, alone, in order to save his friends.

episodes.title: Holly è in pericolo
episodes.synopsis: The Searchers are attacked by the Black Worms, who are under Gray Wolf's command. Tiger must save the group and come over the realization that he must be the one to defeat his brother.

episodes.title: Mocchi entra in azione
episodes.synopsis: While wandering through a hude, dark forest, the Searchers are captured by a group of Moks, led by their captain, a dark Mok named Ebony. Mocchi manages to escape, and befriends a Ducken, who had been hiding in the forest from the Moks. Can Mocchi save Genki and the others or will his efforts get his new friend captured as well?

episodes.title: Il lago di Undine
episodes.synopsis: Genki and his friends come across a trio of Centaurs, proud warriors who serve Moo, but have a code of honor of their own. They challenge the Searchers to a tournament, but there is a squad of Salamanders in the area as well, and they don't want the Centaur to have the glory of Genki's capture.

episodes.title: Un guerriero valoroso
episodes.synopsis: The Searchers come across a small, quiet lake in the forest. They decide to restock their food supplies with fish. However, the lake has another inhabitant, an Undine. Golem falls in love with the beautiful water spirit, but she turns out to be a servant of Moo. Will he be able to defeat her?

episodes.title: Melcarba
episodes.synopsis: While running from a squad of creatures called JaggerNauts, Genki and the others stumble across a factory. The JaggerNauts follow them into the factory, and they battle. However, an android, Melcarba, is still lying dormant in the factory for millions of years and kills all of the JaggerNauts. Then it turns on the Searchers, and they have to use the lightning storm to shut down the derranged cyborg.

info.title: AkaKill! Theater
info.synopsis: Special di Akame ga Kill!

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #01 - Tatsumi and Leone
episodes.synopsis: Tatsumi recounts the beginning of his time in the Capital. He recalls how he was scammed by Leone out of all his money, before being taken in by a seemingly kind noble family.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #02 - 1-Minute Meals
episodes.synopsis: Leone presents her latest culinary creation, a dish called "1-Minute Meal," to Najenda. However, Najenda immediately recognizes that it looks like garbage.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #03 - Hot Springs
episodes.synopsis: The episode begins with Leone complaining that the main series lacks fanservice, suggesting that it's all put into the extra segments.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #04 - TV Shopping, Part 1
episodes.synopsis: The special begins with a commercial for the "Tyrant," a giant, dragon-like Imperial Arms. Lubbock appears as the presenter, selling the "Tyrant Enhancement Super Set" to Tatsumi and the rest of Night Raid. The commercial promotes how the set can enhance your "body" by turning you into a powerful dragon, just like the original user.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #05 - Glasses
episodes.synopsis: Tatsumi is speaking with Sheele and mentions that her clumsiness is so extreme she once put Mine in the laundry with the rest of the clothes.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #06 - Esdeath's Fun Class on Torture
episodes.synopsis: In this short episode, the focus is on the character Esdeath in a humorous, exaggerated setting of a torture chamber classroom

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #07 - Field Trip
episodes.synopsis: The characters (members of Night Raid / Empire cast) go on a field trip—likely for “social studies” in the sense of a school‑style outing rather than a serious mission.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #08 - The Tale of Estaro
episodes.synopsis: The plot of "The Tale of Estaro" is a gag that pokes fun at the relationship between Wave and Kurome, particularly Wave's attempts to connect with Kurome despite her withdrawn nature.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #09 - Interview
episodes.synopsis: This short parodies the main events of Akame ga Kill! episode 9, "Kill the Battle Fanatic," where Tatsumi participates in a martial arts tournament and is aggressively wooed by the general Esdeath.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #10 - DX Demon Armor Incursio
episodes.synopsis: An advertisement for a toy version of the Teigu “Incursio” (the Demon Armor wielded by Tatsumi) appears, promoting it as an amazing product that can fly through sky, sea, and land.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #11 - Girl's Bar
episodes.synopsis: The gags likely include character mismatches: perhaps male/assassin characters like Tatsumi or Lubbock being in a girls‑bar context, or female characters like Leone, Akame, Mine being in bar hostess/maid style roles for comedic effect.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #12 - TV Shopping, Part 2
episodes.synopsis: The episode probably features characters reacting to or creating a spoof commercial for a product (likely a Teigu or weapon‑toy) in the style of a home‑shopping infomercial.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #13 - A New Hideout
episodes.synopsis: Unlike the hidden, somewhat spartan base in the main story, the theater skit humorously portrays the new hideout as a comfortable apartment with modern conveniences, creating a contrast that is a staple of these comedic shorts.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #14 - A Serious Love
episodes.synopsis: Tatsumi and Esdeath run into each other by chance while they are both hunting Danger Beasts in a forest.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #15 - Seryu's Fun Safety Class
episodes.synopsis: Seryu conducts a “crime‐prevention class” (i.e., a classroom setting) where she instructs or demonstrates to other characters (or perhaps viewers) the “right way” to prevent crime.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #16 - Mom's Memories...?!
episodes.synopsis: Tatsumi and the other Night Raid members are discussing their family histories. When the conversation turns to Tatsumi's mother, he admits he knows very little about her.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #17 - Haunted House
episodes.synopsis: The episode opens with Lubbock trying to tell a scary story to the members of Night Raid: Najenda, Leone, Akame and Susanoo. He claims a haunted‑house tale.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #18 - Flash of Lightning! Susanoo
episodes.synopsis: The short opens in the Night Raid headquarters (or a comfortable setting at their base). A sudden scream echoes from somewhere in the building.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #19 - Syura's Comedy
episodes.synopsis: Syura, the arrogant son of the Prime Minister, showing off and bragging about his power.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #20 - TV Shopping, Part 3
episodes.synopsis: In the segment, Tatsumi is attempting to sell a set of gardening tools.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #21 - A Folk Tale: The Grateful Crane
episodes.synopsis: Leone plays the part of the Grateful Crane and Tatsumi takes the role of the kind-hearted young man.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #22 - Akame and Kurome
episodes.synopsis: The short plays on the audience's perception of Tatsumi as the central protagonist for much of the series.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #23 - Setting Out on a Journey
episodes.synopsis: Tatsumi reunites with everyone.

episodes.title: AkaKill! Theater #24 - Wrap Party
episodes.synopsis: Wrap Party in heaven.

info.synopsis: Seconda stagione di Tonbo!

episodes.title: I Love This Island and I Love Golf Too!
episodes.synopsis: Having decided to leave Hinoshima, Tonbo boards a ferry with Igarashi, bound for Kagoshima. On the ship, the two reflect on their time living on the island. Through playing golf with "Igaiga", Tonbo's world begins to broaden. As she starts to look toward the future, the warm presence of the island's residents, who have been watching over her, stays by her side.

episodes.title: Tonbo's Course Debut!
episodes.synopsis: Igarashi sends Tonbo, now a high schooler, to stay at a golf practice range in Kumamoto run by a friend who trains junior players. When Tonbo tries a driver shot for the first time, the other students are puzzled by her skill. She soon gets a chance to practice at a nearby course, where she meets Hinoki Otowa, a talented junior golfer known for her performance at the Kyushu Junior Championship.

episodes.title: Igaiga's Parting Gift
episodes.synopsis: Tonbo and Hinoki hit the golf course for practice. As Tonbo unleashes bold, carefree shots, Hinoki’s view of her begins to change. Despite the strong winds, they exchange impressive plays. Meanwhile, Igarashi arrives with a special gift for Tonbo, who's just started her new life in Kumamoto.

episodes.title: It Begins! The Kyushu Women's Championship
episodes.synopsis: After witnessing Tonbo's golfing style up close, Coach Hajime is determined to unlock her potential by entering her in the Kyushu Women's Championship. However, she must meet the eligibility criteria first. As Tonbo starts her new high school life, things get hectic as she learns to juggle school, going to the practice range, and practicing on the golf course to secure her spot in the tournament.

episodes.title: Career Average Stroke
episodes.synopsis: Though on the first day of the Kyushu Women’s Championship there were many players around Tonbo's age, she ended up paired with a housewife golfer named “Shima-san.” Her skills being just barely above the cutoff line irritates some fellow competitors. However, as the championship progresses, Shima-san’s unique approach to golf begins to influence her fellow competitors playing style!

episodes.title: My Rival Is the Title Holder
episodes.synopsis: Tonbo joins her first tournament, playing with a bold, freewheeling golf style that puts her in the lead on day one. On the second day, she's paired with the other top players from the first round: Hinoki, Tsubura, and Ema, who placed second. With Ema fighting for a comeback after a rough past, their group’s round ignites from the very first hole!

episodes.title: Jack-in-the-box Golf
episodes.synopsis: On day two of the tournament, Tonbo, Hinoki, Tsubura, and Ema are paired up. Hinoki faces pressure from her father, Tsubura plays in her usual style, and Ema makes her comeback. Amidst this heated battle, Tonbo, as always, sticks to her carefree style. Then, driven by her father’s relentless push to be "number one," Hinoki makes a surprising move...

episodes.title: The Tossing and Turning Winds
episodes.synopsis: The night before the tournament’s final day, Igarashi arrives in Kumamoto. Noticing a change in Tonbo, he offers advice to draw out her strengths.On the last day, Tonbo, with her trainee caddie Nishida, faces challenging, windy conditions. Skillfully using the wind to her advantage, she climbs the leaderboard, making Hinoki, Tsubura, and Ema recognize her as a serious rival for the title.

episodes.title: Hinoki's Troubles
episodes.synopsis: On the final day of the tournament, Tonbo plays in her free-spirited style while Hinoki, Tsubura, and Emma close in, their competitive edges starting to show. Hinoki leads at the halfway point, but looks glum despite that. In the second half, Hinoki’s shot hits a tree branch, leading to an unexpected setback…

episodes.title: First Time Under Pressure
episodes.synopsis: On the final day of the tournament, Hinoki turns a penalty into a mental reset. Tsubura stays steady with strategic play, while Emma takes a risky shot despite her injured leg. Meanwhile, Tonbo begins to feel the weight of competition, spurring a change in her resolve.

episodes.title: Tonbo, Hole Out
episodes.synopsis: With three holes left on the final day, Tonbo makes a charge, closing in on the leader. Meanwhile, Tsubura and Emma struggle to improve their scores, while Hinoki regains composure to recover. Suddenly, all four are tied, setting the stage for a dramatic finish. On the final hole, Tonbo's tee shot takes an unexpected turn, changing everything.

episodes.title: Winner and Courage
episodes.synopsis: Emma pushes through the pain of her injured leg for the sake of her swing, Hinoki battles her inner limits, and Tsubura stays true to her own style. Watching from the sidelines, Tonbo cheers them on. An intense showdown over a single final stroke builds to a thrilling, unexpected finish.

episodes.title: Tonbo's Challenge: Heroines of Kyushu
episodes.synopsis: After competing in the Kyushu Women’s Championship, Tonbo travels to Hinoshima with Igarashi to report the results. Together, they reflect on their new challenges in Kumamoto. Along the way, they recall the people who supported Tonbo and the rivals she faced in her first tournament, each with their own aspirations. Tonbo's journey through golf continues to soar—unstoppable and full of promise.

episodes.title: The Beginning and the End! Food Fight Festival!
episodes.synopsis: The food fight festival is here, and the Rentaro Family moves out in order to win the special gelato for themselves. Will they be successful?

episodes.title: What Does the Maid See?
episodes.synopsis: Hakari laments the change in her once dignified mother. Meanwhile, Hahari's maid piques the gang's curiosity.

episodes.title: Super Soaked Maid Party
episodes.synopsis: Only one way to welcome a maid into the crew: everyone changes into maid outfits and has a shootout!

episodes.title: Most Athletes Are Masochists
episodes.synopsis: While the girlfriends are forced to work out, Rentaro runs into a girl who punishes herself for other reasons.

episodes.title: A Homerun Promise
episodes.synopsis: It's time for the big game. Will the Rentaro Family win and ensure the baseball team's survival?

episodes.title: Karaoke Crisis
episodes.synopsis: The gang goes to karaoke! But how will Shizuka manage?

episodes.title: The Beautiful and the Bold
episodes.synopsis: Mimimi and Nano face off in a Beauty Search contest to determine who'll be exiled from the Rentaro Family.

episodes.title: The World Hair Only Grows
episodes.synopsis: With Rentaro still shaved from the beauty search, the gang decide to show solidarity... to disastrous results.

episodes.title: Peekaboy-Meets-Girl
episodes.synopsis: Kakure Meme is an extremely shy girl who wishes to live life as a no-name background character. Will she succeed?

episodes.title: Tsundere Lost

episodes.title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, Really Love You (89 to Go)
episodes.synopsis: Rentaro has come up with a convoluted plan to get Karane's tsundere back. Will it work out?

episodes.title: August 11th: Put Her Back Where She Was
episodes.synopsis: In a hot summer day, after receiving a watermelon from the Hidamari landlady, Yuno and her friends make a visit to a local swimming pool, where Yuno's inability to swim and fear of water is revealed. Meanwhile, Yoshinoya, the Hidamari landlady, and the Principal spend their time together in a school swimming pool.

episodes.title: November 27th: Is It Love?
episodes.synopsis: To Yuno, Miyako, and Sae's surprise, Hiro receives a love letter from a 3rd grade classmate. After hearing the news, Hiro's friends can hardly concentrate on the class as they are very curious about the love letter. After school is over, the classmate who write the love letter confesses his love for Hiro on the rooftop. However, on the next day, she writes him a letter of refusal, to everyone's disappointment. However, Hiro's friends look up to her for her maturity.

info.title: Good Luck! Ninomiya-kun
info.synopsis: Tsukimura Mayu è una sucube.. che può assorbire l'energia vitale attraverso un bacio, peccato che soffra di problemi di androfobia... l'unico che può avvicinarsi a lei senza subirne il fascino è Ninomiya Shugo. Per curarne l'androfobia si trasferisce a casa del ragazzo.

episodes.title: I`m Gonna Kiss You
episodes.synopsis: Shungo meets Mayu at his school, and learns about Mayu's condition.

episodes.title: I`m Gonna Push You!
episodes.synopsis: Reika is introduced and gets worked up when Mayu unknowingly makes fun of her. Reika challenges Mayu to a contest for Shungo, only to lose and be blackmailed into becoming his maid.

episodes.title: Let`s Go to Town
episodes.synopsis: Hinako takes Mayu out to get to know her better, while Reika attempts to get rid of Mayu by exploiting her fear of men.

episodes.title: Let`s Take Care of the House
episodes.synopsis: Mayu attempts to help Reika with the housework, only to find a hidden passage instead. They get trapped within the passages for most of the day, only to be abducted by Ryōko for slacking off when they finally escape.

episodes.title: Let`s Go to the Beach
episodes.synopsis: The crew go to the beach for a 'vacation', where Mayu starts getting closer to Shungo as Reika continues to try to upstage her. After witnessing Shungo inviting Mayu to watch the stars together, Reika wanders off in a depression. Shungo runs off to find her, only to meet her inner self instead. Things end with the appearance of a mysterious group of soldiers.

episodes.title: Remember!
episodes.synopsis: Shungo, Mayu and Reika are attacked by soldiers and are held captive in the house. Shungo fights back but is beaten up after being knocked out by a mysterious woman in a Tiki mask. Reika exploits Mayu's bad luck to trigger the various traps in the forest, spreading chaos among the enemy. She uses this as a diversion to free Shungo, who then faces off against the mysterious woman.

episodes.title: Cheer Up!
episodes.synopsis: Shungo falls ill after 'losing his fighting spirit' and Mayu tries to nurse him back to health, with disastrous results.

episodes.title: Let Me Eat It!
episodes.synopsis: Ryōko orders Shungo to make some ramen for her. He and Mayu spend hours trying to create the perfect ramen, only to realize that Ryōko will settle for a simple cup ramen.

episodes.title: Snatch Him!
episodes.synopsis: The class is at Kyoto on a field trip, the boys try to get into the girl's room but are hunted down by the various faculty members. After being taunted by Tasuku, Shungo tries to force his way in to see Mayu, only to be intercepted by Irori.

episodes.title: Let`s Go Have Fun!
episodes.synopsis: Shungo, Mayu and Reika spend the last day in Kyoto having fun together, like they did back when they were children. Tasuku tries to break them up by using his family's ninja-clan to eliminate Mayu, only to be stopped by Irori. Irori confesses her love to Tasuku and tells him she has only loved him, not Shungo. Mayu leaves the house and Shungo is under arrest.

episodes.title: Don`t Run Away!
episodes.synopsis: Reika's inner self has taken over and uses her corporate muscle to separate Shungo from Ryōko in an attempt to restore his memory. After reminiscing with Reika, he's drugged and held captive (plus nearly raped) in order to keep him from Mayu. Irori and Tasuku then combine forces with Shungo's other friends in an attempt to rescue him.

episodes.title: Let`s Walk Forward!
episodes.synopsis: Shungo races to find Mayu before she runs out of energy, only to run up against Hosaka. Mayu sacrifices herself to save him, only to be accidentally revived by the now complete Reika.

info.title: Inferno Cop
info.synopsis: Esistono delle creature che abitano nel buio, che non possono essere viste ad occhio nudo. A volte questi mostri sguainano le loro immonde zanne ed attaccano senza misericordia uomini, donne e bambini. Inferno Cop, che pure proviene dalle profondità dell'Inferno, una creatura votata alla giustizia, che veglia sugli umani cercando di prevenire queste brutali violenze.

info.title: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman (ITA)
info.synopsis: Beryl Gardernant è un umile maestro di spada che ha un dojo nel regno di Reveris. La sua vita cambia drasticamente quando una sua ex allieva si reca da lui per informarlo di averlo raccomandato come insegnante speciale presso l'ordine dei cavalieri. In questo modo incontra nuovamente i suoi allievi che ora sono diventati cavalieri, avventurieri e maghi di prima classe. Anche se tutti lo adorano, Beryl ha sempre ritenuto di non essere molto forte e continua a non rendersi conto dell'incredibile potere che possiede.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes to the Capital
episodes.synopsis: Beryl Gardenant lives a quiet life running a dojo in the backwaters, until Allucia, his former student, appears with a new job for him – special instructor to the knights she commands! Beryl accepts the job, but Vice-Commander Henblitz doesn’t think he’s up to the task and challenges him to a duel.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Is Astounded by a Wizard
episodes.synopsis: Allucia reminisces about her training with Beryl, and her resolve to have him instruct the knights hardens. While taking in the city sights with Curuni, Beryl meets up with Ficelle, another former student. She surprises him with her magic. But another wizard gives him even more of a surprise!

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Weathers a Fierce Attack
episodes.synopsis: Former student and top-ranking adventurer Surena enlists Beryl’s help to train new adventurers. At the Adventurer’s Guild, Beryl ends up in a duel with her to prove he has what it takes for the job. He isn’t really happy with the turn of events, but Surena seems to feel differently.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Takes Flight with a Monster
episodes.synopsis: To protect the new adventurers, Beryl faces off against a dangerous monster. Unlike other opponents, it acts on instinct, and he’s drawn into a ferocious battle, unable to get a read on its moves. Later on, he faces an encounter that will turn his future upside down.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Enraged by the Bad Guys
episodes.synopsis: Beryl encounters a pickpocket. Seeing the despair in her eyes, he confronts her in an attempt to get her to open up, but it’s not as easy as he thinks. With the help of Allucia and Lucy, he strives to help her free herself from the clutches of shadowy forces and the evil that binds her.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Faces the Dead
episodes.synopsis: Someone is controlling the lowlifes taking advantage of Mewi behind the scenes. Religion and international relations come to the forefront, and with no ties that might cause an international incident, Beryl is asked to flush out the mastermind. New sword in hand, Beryl battles for Mewi’s future.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Learns the Challenges of Parenting
episodes.synopsis: Beryl and Mewi start living in the house Lucy gave Beryl. Although unsure, Beryl works on becoming a parent figure for Mewi. When they find out that the magic institute Mewi is enrolled at has a student dormitory, Beryl wonders whether it is best for her to live with him, or on campus.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Struck by a Lightning-Fast Sword
episodes.synopsis: When a delegation from a neighboring country arrives, Allucia asks Beryl to help guard the VIPs, and he can’t refuse. Beryl needs the right clothes for the job, so he and Allucia go shopping. It’s just like a date! The next day, Allucia approaches Beryl with an offer.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes on His First Hunt in Ages
episodes.synopsis: Mewi needs a new bag for school, so Beryl goes shopping. But he quickly realizes just how expensive bags can be! A job offer from Surena provides a means to make some extra cash, and he jumps at the chance. But he soon realizes – this job is one even high-ranking adventurers have never completed!

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Guards a Princess
episodes.synopsis: The Vice Commander of the Holy Order of the Church of Sphene is Beryl’s former student, Rose, and he renews his ties with her. When the delegation arrives, Beryl is assigned to guard the two royal families as they tour the capital. But a shadow looms over what is supposed to be a joyous event.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Throws Himself Into a Deadly Fight
episodes.synopsis: Beryl helps protect the royal family from assassins, but the assassins all kill themselves, and any clues to the mastermind are lost. Lucy thinks a conflict between royalty and religion is at play. Despite Beryl wanting to cancel the tour of the capital to keep the prince safe, the plan goes ahead.

episodes.title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Praised as a Master Swordsman
episodes.synopsis: It was Rose behind the flood of assassins. Beryl confronts her in an effort to find where her true intentions lie. Rose tells him, and the two draw their swords against each other. What will the outcome be in this battle between master and student?

info.title: Five Numbers!
info.synopsis: La storia è ambientata in una prigione di massima sicurezza, i criminali sono detenuti in celle isolate e sedati in un sonno profondo. Un giorno, grazie ad un improvviso, quanto misterioso, calo di corrente, le porte delle celle si aprono e 5 soggetti vengono liberati dalla propria prigionia. Un ragazzo, un'attraente donna, un ex soldato di mezza età, una hacker e un vecchio, non riescono a trovare l’uscita, e si stupiscono per l’assenza di guardie e l’anomala presenza di un gatto nero…

info.title: Megane-bu!
info.synopsis: La storia segue 5 ragazzi delle superiori tutti con differenti interessi, ma accumunati da un particolare fascino e dalla scarsità della loro vista, che li porta ad indossare gli occhiali. I 5 ne fanno un vezzo, in una città come Sabae, della prefettura di Fujui, rinomata in tutto il Giappone proprio per la produzione di occhiali; decidono così di fondare un club a tema, il "Meganebu", letteralmente il club degli occhiali.

episodes.title: We Don`t Use Glasses Merely As a Vision Correction Tool or a Fashion Accessory (...) That Is Our Glasses Club.
episodes.synopsis: The Glasses Club (comprising of five boys: Akira, Mitsuki, Takuma, Yukiya and Hayato) are determined to successfully create a pair of X-ray glasses in time for the school's vision test, in order to see the female nurse giving out the test naked.

episodes.title: Any Man Who Wears Glasses Cannot Be a Bad Man
episodes.synopsis: Part 1: While cleaning the old club room, Hayato find the Glasses Club's photo albums and remembers when he saw the Glasses Club for the first time at the entrance ceremony. Part 2: After testing out frame strength on glasses after school, Yukiya has some bad luck on his way to Akira's house.

episodes.title: I Hope You Finish the X-Ray Glasses
episodes.synopsis: The Glasses Club neglects their studies in their busy pursuit of the development of the X-Ray Glasses Mk. 35. They come up with a secret plan to get them to their fun club activities faster: they create 55 minute clocks, and swap them out for the clocks all over the school. What they don't realize is that this will cut their club activities short too...

episodes.title: This Is What It Means to Wear Real Glasses! / Glasses Reflect the Soul and Who You Truly Are
episodes.synopsis: Mitsuki stares into the mirror, practicing different ways to get the corners of his mouth to line up with his glasses when he smiles. One particular smile causes a golden light to shine from his face. The ratio of the distance between the corners of his mouth and the distances between the corners of his mouth to his glasses is 1:1.618. Mitsuki overflows with hope as he realizes what he's done. Morning. The birds sing in the trees. An alarm clock goes off. Takuma rolls out of bed; he's bent his temple. This is a day in the life of the Suzumine brothers.

episodes.title: Even If He Is, He Wouldn`t Tell Some Jerk in Fake Glasses. / It`s an Ultrasonic Cleaner for Glasses with Lenses.
episodes.synopsis: In Part 1, Akira's fear of bugs keeps him from running an errand for Mr. Shirogane and going to the club on time. In Part 2, the club tests their newest X-ray glasses model by powering it with a five person bike. When it fails, they go on a bike ride, and eventually get caught in the rain.

episodes.title: MR
episodes.synopsis: Akira conducts an MR (megeane lens) Snap Inspection to test the quality of the club member's lenses. Afterwards, they find a flyer advertising Glasses Celeb, a new type of glasses wipe. The club goes all over town trying to buy some, but it's sold out in every drug store they visit. Little do they know, that this is a scheme by the Himaraya Student Council.

episodes.title: Come, Glasses Wearers! Your Glasses Will Change the World!
episodes.synopsis: The Student Council threatens to disband the Glasses Club if they don't find a fifth member by the end of the day.

episodes.title: As Long As My Glasses Sparkle, You Won`t Get Away With It!
episodes.synopsis: The Glasses Club members have some bad luck during lunch time. Mitsuki believes it was all a set up and tries to find the culprit behind it.

episodes.title: A Revolution for Glasses Wearers
episodes.synopsis: Akira, Takuma, and Yukiya go on a field trip to Okinawa and end up stranded on a deserted island. Meanwhile, Mitsuki really misses Akira.

episodes.title: The Rules Say You`re Safe, But Glasses Say You`re Out / When I Look at the Glasses Club, It Makes Me Think of Us Back Then
episodes.synopsis: The Glasses Club find a cursed Glasses Sugoroku game, which puts them in a life or death situation. Shirogane reminisces about when he was a Hima High student.

episodes.title: It`s Only Natural That Glasses Wearers Love Glasses
episodes.synopsis: Hima High is preparing for the upcoming culture festival. The Student Council plans to build a tower, titled the "Grand Cross Blizzard Eternal SS Tower", as the main attraction, but no one else in the school helps out. The Glasses Club decides to help out after Akira overhears President William talk about how he wanted to build the tower to make Hima High more popular.

episodes.title: Glasses Club!
episodes.synopsis: It's the day of the Hima High culture festival. The Glasses Club's display, the "Come Glasses Wearers! Treasure Hunt Game", becomes very popular with the other students and gets them all to wear glasses, but in all the excitement the X-ray Glasses Mk. 42 go missing. Later, the Grand Cross Blizzard Eternal SS Tower is unveiled.

info.title: Naruto Shippuden Movie 05: La prigione insanguinata
info.synopsis: Dopo la cattura per il tentato omicidio del Quarto Raikage, ed in concomitanza con l'assassinio di due jonin rispettivamente del Villaggio della Nuvola e della Roccia, Naruto viene rinchiuso nella prigione di Hozukijou, meglio nota come la "prigione insanguinata" del Villaggio dell'Erba. Mui, il padrone del castello, usa una tecnica di sigillo per rubare ai prigionieri i loro poteri. Qui comincia la battaglia per svelare la verità dietro i misteriosi omicidi e provare l'innocenza di Naruto.

episodes.title: Qin`s Stumbling Block
episodes.synopsis: Li Mu visits Zheng with a proposal--and a warning. The Fei Xin Force holds grueling tryouts for new recruits.

episodes.title: The Rising Tumult
episodes.synopsis: Lord Changwen turns to an old enemy for help as Qin struggles to devise a valid strategy to conquer Zhao.

episodes.title: The Qin Army Lineup
episodes.synopsis: A large army is gathered in the royal capital of Xianyang in preparation for an all-out battle against the Zhao army led by Li Mu. The commander-in-chief, Changping Jun, announces that the battle will be an allied battle between Kanki, Yang Duanhe, and Wang Jian, and announces the "commander-in-chief" of the entire army. Meanwhile, upon receiving news that the Qin army has begun its invasion, Li Mu orders the army to assemble at the castle on the western front line to counter the attack. He also gives some advice to Shunsuiju, one of his confidants in charge of intelligence gathering.

episodes.title: Zhao`s National Gate
episodes.synopsis: As the Qin army changes course and Zhao responds, the many benefits of an allied army soon become clear.

episodes.title: Storming Liewei
episodes.synopsis: The Fei Xin Force and the mountainfolk must conquer Liewei, but there's no escaping the realities of war.

episodes.title: Liewei`s Trap
episodes.synopsis: Something's strange about Liewei--and it may mean Qin's grand strategy for conquering Zhao is all for nothing.

episodes.title: Weapons of Conquest
episodes.synopsis: Wang Jian's new strategy devises an unexpected weapon, sending Li Mu scrambling to craft a counterattack.

episodes.title: The Battle Begins

episodes.title: The Weight of Resolve
episodes.synopsis: As the battle heats up, Wang Ben grows frustrated with the role his father has assigned to the Yu Feng Force.

episodes.title: Descendants of the Quanrong
episodes.synopsis: Wang Ben confronts Mǎ Nanci. The Zhao army seeks help in their battle against Yang Duanhe's mountain army.

episodes.title: The One-Hit-Kill Detached Force
episodes.synopsis: The tides of battle turn as the Fei Xin Force makes their move. Meng Tian joins Xin on a crucial side mission.

episodes.title: Insufficient Rank

episodes.title: A Great General`s View
episodes.synopsis: Wang Ben finds himself in the thick of battle. The Fei Xin Force looks back on the first few days of the war.

info.title: No Home
info.synopsis: Hae-Jun Go, che è scappato di casa, ed Eun-Yeong Baek, il ragazzo problematico che vive in una tenda. Questi due, che si incontrano in circostanze terribili, sono costretti a vivere insieme in un dormitorio abbandonato. È una storia di crescita difficile tra due persone che odiano sia il dormitorio sia l’un l’altra.

info.title: Yami Shibai 16
info.synopsis: Yami Shibai 16 (Yamishibai: Japanese Ghost Stories) è una anime horror. Ogni pomeriggio alle cinque, un uomo mascherato, il Gaito kamishibaiya, appare al parco giochi. Si presenta sempre con un teatrino mobile, col quale rappresenta, attraverso la tecnica del kamishibai, diverse storie dell'orrore e leggende metropolitane autoconclusive, con figure e temi tipici del folclore giapponese.

info.title: Release that Witch
info.synopsis: Il moderno Cheng Yan muore inaspettatamente e la sua anima viaggia su un continente di un altro mondo dall'ambientazione medievale europea, diventando Roland, il quarto principe del Regno di Graycastle. Questo principe dissoluto salva la strega Anna durante una scena di esecuzione e scopre con stupore che la magia esiste davvero in questo mondo medievale. Quando Anna, in quanto strega, mostra le sue abilità magiche, Roland comprende che la magia può sostituire alcune tecnologie moderne, e formula così un piano di "grande sviluppo dell'industria magica". Così, in un'epoca in cui tutti odiano le streghe, il determinato Roland inizia a reclutarle, utilizzando la loro magia per trasformare la Città di Confine e migliorare la vita propria e degli abitanti locali. Oltre ad usare la magia per sviluppare l'industria, Roland introduce anche moderne idee commerciali nella Città di Confine. Sotto la guida di Roland, la gente produce armi da fuoco e Roland ottiene il sostegno popolare. Man mano che il numero di streghe nel campo di Roland aumenta, l'industria magica continua a progredire. Nel frattempo, Roland dovrà affrontare battaglie contro le grandi famiglie e gli altri principi e principesse. Con l'espandersi del suo territorio, Roland crea con successo una coesistenza armoniosa tra streghe e persone comuni, portando gradualmente sotto il suo dominio il territorio occidentale di Graycastle e persino l'intero regno, e svelando lentamente i segreti della razza dei demoni e dell'Impero delle Streghe.

info.title: La ragazza che saltava nel tempo
info.synopsis: La ragazza che saltava nel tempo racconta la storia di Makoto Konno una studentessa delle superiori che un giorno inciampa nel laboratorio di scienze e per sbaglio urta un congegno per il viaggio nel tempo. Dopo questo avvenimento scopre che se compie un salto abbastanza lungo riesce a tornare indietro nel tempo ad un momento a scelta della sua vita. Makoto inizia quindi ad utilizzare questo potere per risolvere problematiche della sua vita o semplicemente per divertirsi. Ma a questo punto scopre che ogni sua azione va ad influire sugli eventi quasi sempre in modo catastrofico e viene costretta ripetutamente ad usare il suo potere per porre rimedio a situazioni problematiche che lei stessa ha causato. Quando il suo amico Chiaki Mamiya le confida di essere innamorato di lei, Makoto torna indietro nel tempo per evitare di sentirselo dire e continuare ad avere un rapporto d'amicizia con il ragazzo, finchè non stravolge i rapporti con i suoi amici e capisce che non ci che vuole.
